title: Non-trivialization probability of arc system in three-dimensional space
summary: The type-specific knotting probability of an arc diagram is earlier defined by using chord diagrams of ribbon surface-links in 4D space. By modifying this notion, Non-Trivialization probability (simply NT probability) for the arc diagram is introduced and generalized to an arc system diagram. Some properties of the NT probability are shown. The method of transforming a polygonal arc in 3D space into a unique arc diagram up to isomorphisms earlier developed is generalized to a polygonal arc system in 3D space to define the NT probability.
